metadata.title: NALP webinar, May 2024 - what is it like working in the Probate Research Industry
metadata.author: NALP - National Association of Licenced Paralegals
metadata.shortDescription: Chantal, PR Director for the National Association of Licensed Paralegals discusses with Ryan Gregory what it is liking working as a paralegal in the Probate Research industry. Join us for 30 minutes of conversation, including a bit about what it is like on TV. Ryan was part of the cast for Heir Hunters
